findings.note: Moor and beach both mean to settle a boat at rest, and cast off and launch both mean to set a boat moving, so a player could solve this as two synonym pairs. Both halves read as: "synonyms meaning 'stop/secure the boat'" and "synonyms meaning 'set the boat moving'".

Moor:launch is stop-vs-start and cast off:beach is start-vs-stop, so both halves share the same opposite relation just paired the other way. Both halves read as: "opposite boat actions (secure vs. set moving)" and "opposite boat actions (set moving vs. secure), reversed".

Nothing forces whether the 'securing' action or the 'releasing' action comes first within each pair; I picked moor→cast off and beach→launch as parallel directions but the reverse order reads equally well.

notes:
set-reverse allows a same-direction synonym cross-reading and its start/stop opposite axis can be paired in either order, so the intended undo-direction never locks; needs new word pairs with a single unambiguous reversal axis.
- set-reverse: Moor/cast off and beach/launch both reduce to 'secure vs. release the boat,' letting a solver group by synonym meaning instead of by directed reversal, and the stop/start axis has no forced order (moor:launch and cast off:beach read equally validly), so order is guessed.
  Try: Replace the set with pairs that share a single non-symmetric undo relation, e.g. 'anchor : weigh anchor' (raise the anchor undoes anchoring) paired with 'dock : cast off' — choose pairs where the second word is uniquely the specific undo-action of the first, not a generic opposite category
  Or: Keep one pair (e.g. moor : cast off) and replace beach/launch with a pair on a different, non-swappable axis such as 'tie up : untie' to avoid the two pairs collapsing into the same secure/release cluster
  Or: Change relationship to something with an inherently fixed order, such as 'a knot and the action that releases it' (e.g. 'hitch : slip' / 'lash : cut loose'), so no synonym or reversed-order cross-reading survives
Do not change: set-taxonomic, set-item-location, set-cause-effect — no allowlisted finding touches them.
